title: A Habitat Imaging-Based Radiomics and Deep Learning Fusion for Preoperative Prediction of Lymphovascular Invasion in Invasive Breast Cancer: A Multicenter Study.
summary: A multicentre fusion of habitat imaging radiomics and deep learning predicted lymphovascular invasion in invasive breast cancer, with diagnostic evaluation reported. The validation design, cohort and reference standard are described in the source, and the conclusion is limited to them. No broader clinical claim follows.
